04 / BEHIND THE MAP

Every line has a source.

Built from the project’s existing route and event records. Sources support different kinds of claims. Evidence, inference and gaps remain visible together.

Download exhibition data ↓
01

A connection is not a complete itinerary

Curves join documented regions. Unverified stops, ports and historical premises remain unlocated. Present-day addresses do not establish historical handover sites.

02

Arrival is not accession

The expedition cargo’s arrival in Paris in 1909 is distinguished from BnF accession in 1910. Cases, scrolls, objects, images and catalogue numbers are not interchangeable units.

03

A batch is not every individual object

Historical links mostly represent batches or collections. Apart from identified catalogue examples, individual manuscripts are not claimed to have complete reconstructed custody chains.
